title: MRR Practice
description: docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2.1: an autonomous research practice's own published identity. Sixteenth entity schema in this repository; first task of Epic E5 (task-packets/E5-T01.yaml). 'keys' carries PUBLIC key material only (see $defs.publicKeyDescriptor) -- never a private key. 'disclosure' is a deliberately minimal reading of section 2.1's 'disclosure and trust metadata', which the spec does not elaborate further (flagged as an open specification question in this task's PR body). 'trust_chain_ref' is an OPTIONAL, opaque reference (docs/spec/02 section 1.3 / task-packets/E5-T01.yaml forbidden_changes) -- carried, never resolved or validated as a chain here. 'signature' is OPTIONAL, unlike node-manifest/task-bundle/evidence-crate's own required 'signature': a practice may SELF-sign its own identity with one of its own listed keys (signer_practice_id equals this Practice's own id), built and verified over the ADR-0004 exclude_none canonical form via the existing mrr.domain.hashing_policy -- deciding whether a Practice is TRUSTED is deferred to E5-T02+.

publicKeyDescriptor.description: One PUBLIC key's identity, validity window, and lifecycle state (docs/spec/04_SECURITY_AND_POLICY.md section 8.4). 'encoded_public_key' is the standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding) encoding of a raw Ed25519 public key -- the same convention ADR-0003-SIGNATURE-VALUE-ENCODING.md pins for signature.value. 'kid' MUST be the deterministic key identifier mrr.crypto.keys.derive_key_id derives from that same key -- checked by mrr.contracts.practice.PublicKeyDescriptor's own model_validator (shape only here; the kid/key consistency and valid_from < valid_until ordering are semantic checks this schema cannot express).

kid.description: Deterministic key identifier derived only from the key's own raw bytes (mrr.crypto.keys.derive_key_id) -- never from a mutable label.

encoded_public_key.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding) of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 PUBLIC key; base64url is not accepted. See docs/spec/adr/ADR-0003-SIGNATURE-VALUE-ENCODING.md. Never a private key.

state.description: docs/spec/04_SECURITY_AND_POLICY.md section 8.4 lifecycle: active, rotated (superseded, kept historically addressable), or revoked (existing objects remain historically attributable).

disclosureAndTrust.description: Deliberately minimal reading of docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2.1's 'disclosure and trust metadata' -- see schema-level description.

max_disclosure.description: Reuses research-score.schema.json's own three-value disclosure ceiling vocabulary.

trust_statement.description: Free-text qualitative trust posture this practice publishes about itself. May be empty.

keys.description: This practice's own PUBLIC signing/identity key material -- never private keys. At least one key is required (a practice with zero keys could sign or verify nothing).

governance_contacts.description: Reachable governance contact references (e.g. mailto:/https: URIs). The key must be present; an empty array is schema-valid.

capability_registry_endpoint.description: Public capability-registry endpoint, if any (docs/spec/02 section 2.1: 'public capability registry endpoint if any').

trust_chain_ref.description: Optional, opaque certificate or trust-chain reference (docs/spec/02 section 1.3). Carried only -- chain validation is out of scope (task-packets/E5-T01.yaml).

signature.description: Optional self-signature: this practice signing its own identity with one of its own listed keys (signer_practice_id equals this Practice's own id).
